content: अभिवादः, -वादनम् .²1 Reverential salutation, respectful obeisance, salutation of a superior or elder by an inferior or junior, or of a teacher by his disciple. It consists in (1) rising from oneʼs seat (प्रत्युत्थान); (2) clasping the feet (पादोपसंग्रह), and (3) repeating the form of salutation (अभिवाद) which includes the name or title of the person addressed, followed by the mention of the personʼs own name. For the different ways of performing obeisance and the merit arising therefrom see <ls>Ms. 2. 120-126</ls>. .²2 Abuse, insulting or scurrilous speech (for अतिवाद).
